svg.aria-label: Serialized notification gift wrap size by tokens per chunk. 19 tokens: 55,121 bytes. 20 to 22 tokens: 66,045 bytes. 23 to 28 tokens: 76,965 bytes. 29 to 32 tokens: NIP-44 encryption fails. A dashed line marks strfry's default 65,536-byte event limit; only 19 tokens fits under it, and the EU White Noise relay rejected 76,965 bytes as event too large.

g.text: 19 tokens is the largest that fits
EU relay: 76,965 bytes is event too large
